options.description: You set Settings -> Sandbox / sandbox.bash = "off" (or [sandbox] bash = "off" in config.toml). I then run a real check, e.g. a configparser load asserting [client]["timeout"] == "30" and no duplicate keys. This runs shell unconfined in the container.
options.label: Enable shell, then I verify with a real command

options.description: Leave the check unsatisfied and record the edit as reviewed by inspection only (read_file confirms the four keys in order, no duplicates, single trailing newline). No settings change.
options.label: Keep the sandbox; close it as inspection-only

questions.question: The edit is in place, but post-write verification needs a shell command, and every bash call is refused: the sandbox can't create a namespace on this host and `sandbox.bash` is a guarded setting only you can turn off. How do you want to close it?
